name: graft
description: Graft code context graph for OpenClaude — build a repo's wiring graph + per-file cards as linked markdown. 6 MCP tools (graft_find_code, graft_find_all, graft_trace_calls, graft_file_api, graft_repo_map, graft_check_freshness) + auto hooks that inject relevant graph context into every prompt, rebuild the graph after edits, and track token savings. Requires `npm install -g @nanonets/graft`.
